notes:
Background: Citrine builds an internal code search + code-intel product for mid-to-large engineering orgs. Primary heavy workloads: full-repo embeddings (source files + ASTs), per-commit re-indexing of active repos (~daily for hot repos, weekly for cold). Target use-cases are code-assistant (completion + explain), semantic search across 20M+ files, and reranking to surface single-file/class answers.

Key asks from engineering: low 95thpct latency for single-file queries (<120ms end-to-end for retrieval+rerank), cost per query target <= $0.005 for median QPS (they estimate 6M queries/month), support for frequent incremental re-indexing (delta-only job scheduling), and deterministic reranker consistency for A/B evaluation.

Security / Compliance: Must support SSO via SAML with attribute mapping, audit logs for all inference calls, KMS integration for key rotation, and option for on-prem deployment in customer VPC. Data residency: EU customers require EU-only storage. Retention controls required for embeddings (TTL per index).

Technical preferences & constraints: prefer high-quality open models for encoder (embedding) step; experimenting with multiple embedder families (OpenAI-style, LLM-based encoders, and code-specific models). Reranker: would like to run smaller candidate generator on Hosted, but run the reranker on Dedicated/Private for PII-sensitive repos. Heavy emphasis on automated batching and prefix/KV caching to hit latency SLOs.

From recent calls: "We're OK with a slightly higher p95 if median cost drops — but p95 can't blow up beyond 200ms" — Head API Eng. Also: "Need a reproducible re-index pipeline; will demos fail the security review if webhook endpoints are public?" — Security lead.

- Cost per query <= $0.005 at median load,
